## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.17.2

### 📷 Recordings
- Preserves X-Sense HLS recording segments exactly as downloaded instead of trying to remux the first segment.
- Improves browser playback of cached HLS recordings by declaring the expected AAC-LC audio codec to hls.js.
- Clears stale HLS recording caches from the previous prerelease generation so affected clips are fetched again before being served.
- Replaces an old HLS cache only after the refreshed cache has been staged and checked.
